sources: Exemplar (WeaponBasicTable wpn_claym_0004): main attribute, ATK and sk_wpn_claym_0004's Physical DMG +phy_damage_up (cardAttributeModifier attribute 50, formulaItem 5) are on the stat panel. sk_wpn_claym_0004 passiveEventActions: abilityEvent 302 (the wielder's damage landing) + CheckDamageDecorateMask checkType 1 mask 768 (battle 256 or ultimate 512) + no buff_wpn_claym_0004_cd → CreateBuff buff_wpn_claym_0004_cd (cd_duraton 0.1 s, the SkillData default: no SkillPatchTable row sets it) and buff_wpn_claym_0004_phy_damage_up (attribute 50 + phy_damage_up2 for `duration` 30 s; stackingType 2, maxStackCntKey max_stack 3: each layer its own timer). Description: "When the wielder's battle skill or ultimate hits the enemy, the wielder gains Physical DMG Dealt +{phy_damage_up2} for {duration}s. Max stacks for effects of the same name: {max_stack}. Duration of each stack is counted separately. Effect only triggers once every 0.1s." Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0009_azrila.md rows E1–E3.

Verified in fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-7e19489ae503.json on Ember: buff_wpn_claym_0004_phy_damage_up layers by her battle-skill landings (two per cast: leap and slam), phy_damage_up2 0.2 at skill level 6. Physical-status hits (Knock Down's own DamageAction, mask 65536) and poise-only landings don't count.
toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01 (atk_up, a key this skill doesn't have): a template leftover with no effect.

triggers.note: abilityEvent 302 with mask 768: the wielder's battle-skill and ultimate landings (not reactions: their mask has no skill bit); buff_wpn_claym_0004_cd (cd_duraton, sic) is the cooldown.
